description: An honest shopping-guide site with guide, about and affiliate disclosure pages; optionally carries a PartnerWhiz verification token.

inputModel.notes: The create-promotion-site entrypoint requires a verification token, one PartnerWhiz meta tag, or explicit --without-verification for the URL-first flow. Generic blueprint generation can omit verification. No product or company data is required.

dataPolicy.reason: Default content is general shopping guidance and never invents products, offers, reviews, traffic or testimonials.
dataPolicy.minimum: No commercial claims or product data required.
